“老……老祖宗？”吴姜非常的激动，没想到自家老祖宗，真的是绿城城隍。

没有犹豫，快步冲上前，“噗通”一声跪在吴崇的脚下，抱着大腿就不松手了。

吴崇看着脚边的吴姜，嘴角抽了抽，心想：你小子不是喜欢在拜神吗？那就直接拜老子吧，反正老子是你祖宗，老子受得起，你最好多磕几个。

吴姜可不知道老祖宗的心思，抱着老祖宗的大腿，直接开嚎：“老祖宗啊，我都来了几次了，你怎么都不搭理我啊？”

“您不知道，前天我碰到一个清朝的老鬼，那家伙老厉害了，厉鬼巅峰的修为，要不是运气好，咱们老吴家差点就断代了。因为什么？就是因为孙儿手里没有保命的宝贝呗！”

吴崇闻言，额头青筋跳了跳，心里暗骂：他奶奶的，就知道会这样，但你他娘的也太直接了吧？

“起来起来！像什么样子！”吴崇赶紧打断吴姜的哭嚎，不耐烦地抬脚，一把将他从腿上扒拉到一边。

“你给老子记住，你现在已经是地府一等鬼差了，身份不一样了，以后不许动不动就进庙拜神，失了身份。往后进了庙里，烧柱香、鞠个躬，意思意思就行了，千万记住，不要行跪拜大礼。”

吴姜从地上爬起来，拍了拍身上不存在的灰尘，挠了挠头，一脸疑惑地问道：“老祖宗，那是不是因为这样，刚才文武判官他们，才不让我拜祭的啊？搞得我还以为哪里得罪了他们呢。”

吴崇翻了个白眼，没好气地说道：“少废话，你小子只要记住我的话就行了。”

随后，吴崇摆了摆手：“好了，叫你进来，就是跟你说这事儿，没别的事，你可以走了！”

这话一出，轮到吴姜急了，连忙上前一步，凑到吴崇跟前，脸上立马堆起谄媚的笑容。

“别呀老祖宗！好不容易见面，咱们多聊会儿呗，哪能说走就走。话说老祖宗啊，现在还是过年期间呢，老祖宗您的红包，还没给我呢！”

吴崇瞬间被气笑了，一脸无语地看着他，老子都死了他妈的多少年了，现在还得给你个小辈发压岁钱？

见老祖宗半天没动静，吴姜眼珠一转，又换上一副委屈巴巴的模样，一手捂着胸口，一边唉声叹气。

Chapter 95 Returning with a Full Load - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

"Old... ancestor?" Wu Jiang was very excited. He didn't expect that his ancestor was really the Green City City God.

Without hesitation, he quickly rushed forward, knelt at Wu Chong's feet with a "pop", and hugged his thighs without letting go.

Wu Chong looked at Wu Jiang at his feet, and the corners of his mouth twitched, thinking: Don't you like to worship gods?Then just worship me. After all, I am your ancestor and I can afford it. You'd better worship me more.

Wu Jiang didn't know what his ancestor was thinking, so he hugged his thigh and howled directly: "Ancestor, I've been here several times, why don't you pay attention to me?"

"You don't know, the day before yesterday I met an old ghost from the Qing Dynasty. That guy is very powerful. If it weren't for good luck, our old Wu family would have almost been wiped out. Why? It's just because my grandson doesn't have a life-saving treasure in his hands!"

When Wu Chong heard this, the veins on his forehead jumped, and he cursed in his heart: His grandma knew this would happen, but you are too damn direct, right?

"Get up! What do you look like!" Wu Chong quickly interrupted Wu Jiang's cry, impatiently raised his feet and pulled him away from his legs.

"Remember me, you are now a first-class ghost in the underworld, and your status is different. From now on, you are not allowed to go to the temple to worship gods. You will lose your status. When you go into the temple, burn incense sticks and bow, it's just what you mean. Remember, don't kneel down and worship."

Wu Jiang got up from the ground, patted the non-existent dust on his body, scratched his head, and asked with confusion: "Ancestor, is that why the civil and military judges didn't let me worship just now? I thought I had offended them somewhere."

Wu Chong rolled his eyes and said angrily: "Stop talking nonsense, you just need to remember my words."

Then, Wu Chong waved his hand: "Okay, I asked you to come in just to tell you about this. If there is nothing else, you can leave!"

As soon as these words came out, it was Wu Jiang's turn to become anxious. He quickly stepped forward and approached Wu Chong, with a flattering smile on his face.

"No, ancestor! It's hard to meet, let's chat for a while, why don't we leave just now. Speaking of ancestors, it's still the Chinese New Year, ancestor, you haven't given me your red envelope yet!"

Wu Chong was instantly angry and laughed, looking at him speechlessly, I've been dead for how many fucking years, and now I still have to give you, a junior, new year's money?

Seeing that his ancestor had been silent for a long time, Wu Jiang rolled his eyes and put on an aggrieved look again. He covered his chest with one hand and sighed.
